general_information.Description: This course equips students with a comprehensive understanding of digital circuits, beginning with foundational topics such as number systems, logic gates, Boolean algebra, and logic expression simplification. It progresses to the design and implementation of logic circuits, including combinational and sequential circuits, shift registers, counters, and data storage elements. The module also introduces hardware description languages (VHDL, FPGA) and basic concepts in signal and data processing. Additionally, the course emphasizes professional ethics, social responsibility, and the development of creative thinking and problem-solving skills through hands-on assignments and laboratory experiments.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: Specific Tools: 1) Simulation software - Tinkercad.com 2) Lab equipments/ Training Kits - Tool: Oscilloscope and Function generator, multimeter - Kit for the lab: List of components in the sheet "Electronics component list"

description: This course equips students with a comprehensive understanding of digital circuits, beginning with foundational topics such as number systems, logic gates, Boolean algebra, and logic expression simplification. It progresses to the design and implementation of logic circuits, including combinational and sequential circuits, shift registers, counters, and data storage elements. The module also introduces hardware description languages (VHDL, FPGA) and basic concepts in signal and data processing. Additionally, the course emphasizes professional ethics, social responsibility, and the development of creative thinking and problem-solving skills through hands-on assignments and laboratory experiments.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the basic knowledge of digital engineering such as number systems, logic gates, Boolean algebra, and logic expression simplification.
Analyze the design and implementation of logic circuits, including combinational and sequential circuits.
Describe the design, operations and functionality of registers, counters, and data storage elements.
Explains the internal structures of the programmable logic devices and how they are used to implement digital logic functions.
Gain insight into how signals and data are controlled and processed in digital systems.
Integrate professional ethics, social responsibility, and the development of creative thinking and problem-solving skills through hands-on assignments and laboratory experiments.
